name: Thrower
description: Spit jets of acid that leave corrosive puddles on the ground.

name: Geyser
description: Summon an acid geyser that erupts on impact and launches enemies into the air.

name: Bubble
description: Throw a big acid bubble that bursts on impact and creates multiple acid puddles.

name: Contagion
description: Corrodes all enemies in a wide zone and applies Contagious, causing them to explode on death.

name: Rain
description: Call down a rain of acid that corrodes enemies in a wide area.

name: Mino
description: Summon a cactus mine that explodes when stepped on.

name: Pistolero
description: Summon a cactus turret that fires continuously at nearby enemies.

name: Wallo
description: Summon cactus spikes that damage and slow enemies on contact.

name: Decoyo
description: Summon a dancing cactus that lures enemies before exploding.

name: Bandito
description: Summon a powerful cactus golem that fights for you for a while.

name: Strikes
description: Launch a line of lightning strikes that zap everything in their path.

name: Boing
description: Instantly jump to escape your enemies.

name: Portal
description: Spawn up to two portals that teleport players and duplicate spell projectiles.

name: Swap
description: Swap position with an enemy, exploding at both locations.

name: Thunderstrike
description: Rise up, then dive down to blast the area and unleash thunder over your enemies.

name: Breeze
description: Summon a breeze that freezes enemies in a wide cone

name: Bridge
description: Summon a bridge that shields allies who cross it.

name: Cube
description: Turn yourself or an ally into an invulnerable ice cube

name: Glaze
description: Release a burst, damaging nearby enemies and shielding nearby allies

name: Blizzard
description: Summon a Blizzard that follows you, damaging and freezing enemies and shielding Allies

name: Fireball
description: Launch a fireball that explodes on impact and leaves the ground burning.

name: Firebeam
description: Unleash a giant fire beam that scorches everything.

name: Surcharge
description: Burn all enemies in a wide zone, detonating those already ablaze.

name: Wisp
description: Summon a wisp that continuously deal extra damage over time, jumping to another enemy on kill.

name: Finger Guns
description: Swap your weapon for fiery fingers that shoot explosive fire bullets.

name: Drain
description: Command your doll to drain an enemy's health.

name: Rescue
description: Command your doll's power to heal or revive the nearest ally.

name: Corruption
description: Channel a doll to corrupt enemies, making them fight for you.

name: Ritual
description: Summon a ring of candles that restores the health of allies within its light.

name: Doll
description: Summon a doll that grants invincibility and high speed to allies within its zone.
